RANK PROTECTION

SHOW UP. BUILD A BUFFER.

Five active days in an exercise earns one shield. Complete at least five clean reps in a camera round to count a day.

  • One shield earned per week. Hold up to two.
  • A shield cushions half a loss, up to 6 rating points.
  • At most one shield is used per exercise per day.
  • Rest days don’t reset progress. Shields don’t expire.

FAIR ROUNDS

THE RULES ARE SIMPLE.

  • Separate push-up and squat ratings. Five placement matches per ladder.
  • Live 1v1: both players ready up, then compete on the same 60-second clock.
  • One attempt each. Most counted reps wins; equal scores draw.
  • 24-point Elo adjusts for opponent rating. Practice earns no rating.

Camera-scored beta: timing and movement checks reduce bad counts, but browser results are not cheat-proof. No money or prizes are at stake.
